types.SM.gate_pair_cast:
SM.gate_pair_cast.{u} {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2] (d h : SignType) (hd : d ≠ 0) (hh : h ≠ 0) :
  ↑(SM.ordinaryGate d h hd hh) = (↑↑d - ↑↑h) * ⅟2 ∧ ↑(SM.rootGate d h hd hh) = (↑↑d + ↑↑h) * ⅟2
types.SM.IntervalComposition.ordinaryWeight_ca:
SM.IntervalComposition.ordinaryWeight_cast.{u} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2]
  {I : SM.BoundaryInterval n} (π : SM.IntervalComposition I) (P : SM.LabelledTuple n) (hP : SM.G1 P) (g : ZMod n) :
  ↑(π.ordinaryWeight P hP g) = π.nearFarWeight (SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g) (SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g)
types.SM.IntervalComposition.rootWeight_cast:
SM.IntervalComposition.rootWeight_cast.{u} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2]

  ↑(π.rootWeight P hP g) = π.nearFarWeight (SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g) (-SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g)

types.SM.geometric_nearFar_open:
SM.geometric_nearFar_open.{u} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n)
  (hP : SM.G1 P) (g : ZMod n) :
  (SM.nearFarTransform (SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g) (SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g) fun I =>
      ↑(SM.openTreeSum P hP g I)) =
    SM.boundaryUnitArray
types.SM.geometric_nearFar_root:
SM.geometric_nearFar_root.{u} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n)
  (hP : SM.G1 P) (g : ZMod n) (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
  ↑(SM.treeCoefficient P hP g hn) =
    SM.nearFarTransform (SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g) (-SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g)
      (fun I => ↑(SM.openTreeSum P hP g I)) (SM.fullBoundaryInterval hn)
